node.title: Canonical minimum-pair-union FR bound
node.closure: elementary set identity with exhaustive finite replay
node.statement: For finite locator sets S_gamma of sizes u_gamma=rho-o_gamma, choose distinct g,h minimizing a*=|S_g union S_h| and put W*=S_g union S_h. Every third supported slope satisfies |S_gamma intersect W*|<=4rho-2a*-2o_gamma-o_g-o_h and |S_gamma\W*|>=2a*-3rho+o_gamma+o_g+o_h. At rho=4m-1, a*=7m-1 and zero defects this is intersection at most 2m-2 and outside spend at least 2m+1. The theorem is purely set-theoretic and applies only to the canonical minimum pair union, not an arbitrary support set; its spend does not by itself close the calibrated rate-half ledger.
